newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand shares end slightly softer, off low.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand shares end slightly softer, off low.

text.p: * New Zealand shares ended softly, off low
* Business picks up in afternoon
* Big lines in Telecom, Brierley Investments transacted ---------------------------(Nov 19)---------------------------
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
317 -2 * NZSC cap index -18.84 at 4,831.80
370 nil * Volume NZ$66.2 million. Futures -4 at 1,175
750 -5 * Other movers - +5 +1
New Zealand share prices ended with a soft tone on Tuesday but a surge of activity in the afternoon helped drag the market off its lows.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index ended 10.02 points down at 2,342.34, off its low of 2,336.67 and its 2,352.36 peak.
Most of the day's NZ$66.2 million in turnover went through in the afternoon, thanks mostly to some large crossings of shares in Telecom and Brierley Investments.
Nigel Scott at BZW said the large afternoon crossings made the market move quite strongly.
Telecom lost five cents to close at NZ$7.50 while Brierley Investments lost one to NZ$1.31.

Air New Zealand B shares gained six cents to end at NZ$3.75, off their high of NZ$3.80. "That's quite a big rally when you think these things were trading at NZ$3.40 on the middle of rights trading," Scott said.
The B shares are now about level with their pre-rights trading price.
Ceramco was showing signs of life before its first half result on Thursday, gaining five to NZ$1.17.
The lingerie and ceramics firm said in September it expects to make a loss of around NZ$1.60 million in the first half to September but to break even over the finanical year.
